description: Lieux de stationnement (organisation Sergent) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sergent. This dataset meets the specifications of the “parking places” scheme available on the website schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Sergent. The portal shows the English title as "Parking places (organisation Sergent)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Sergent. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
